preview_2026.line: Dead even at 6-6 and Eero took the last one by 0.86. Anton has won two straight and ESPN likes him by 17.
Allu leads the series 9-5 but has lost three straight. Oliver has won three in a row. ESPN calls it a coin flip.
Jan leads 6-3 all time, but four teams on bye have his projection at 56. Jose brings a four-game win streak.
Juho leads 9-6 and ESPN even has him ahead. Makkis just dropped 174, so good luck with that.
Two teams on three-game skids. Niko leads 10-8 and the projection by 17. Jussi needs another Pollard miracle.
Series tied 3-3. Joel is 6-1 but missing three guys to IR, Peetu needs this before the season slips away.

5-1 and the best record, but Makkis just hung 149 on him. The streak is over, the swagger isn't.
Back-to-back wins and suddenly the Faithful are believing again. Don't look at the 3-3.
Two straight losses, still scoring like a top-four team. Golden Nuggets, slightly tarnished.
86 points in week 6. The Spartans forgot their shields.
Three straight wins after an 0-3 start. The champ's belt is coming back out of the closet.
Won by 2.06 and called it a statement. It wasn't.
Two straight losses and sliding. The poop is wobbling on the stick.
Snapped a three-game skid by 4.84. The Molotov still hasn't been lit.
27€ in fines and 2-4. Leading the league in donations, not wins.
Won the week with 79.50. Take the W, nobody's checking the score.
6% all-play. Would have lost to almost everyone, almost every week. Danger zone resident.

138 points, back-to-back wins and up four spots, with DeVonta Smith, Warren and Love all out. Scary when healthy.
Four straight wins after an 0-3 start and the biggest climber of the week. The champ is awake.
6-1 and the best record in the league, but three guys on IR and Likely on bye sink the outlook. Rich but limping.
Three straight losses and the low score of the week. The second-best projection and the softest run ahead are doing all the lifting.
Won by 1.26 and ESPN gives him the best lineup in the league next week. Then come Makkis, Niko and Peetu. Enjoy it.
Won again and still fell four spots. Montgomery out, Nabers on bye, and the outlook took the hit.
Lost by almost 30 to Anton, Mike Evans is still out and the new QB Stroud is on bye. Sliding fast.

Two straight losses and a medical tent of Breece Hall, Lamar and Monangai. At least he paid no fines this week.
